items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All iterate-spec ACs implemented: hygiene filtering via shared detector, JS prefix-strip fallback, Python drop, filter-before-cap, per-file dedup, no gate-side changes, follow-up triage card minted.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Pure string filtering over already try/except-guarded file reads; load_shared_module raises loudly (uncaught) on a missing shared/ tree by design, not swallowed.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input reaches SQL/HTML, no secrets, no auth routes touched — pure in-process text classification over already-local test-file contents.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 22 tests assert on mine_acceptance_criteria's return value (outcomes), one happy + one dirty/error path per branch (JS combined-clean, prefix-strip, bare-dirty, nested, dedup, all-dirty, Python clean/dirty, fallthrough, cap-interaction).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Same regex-based, single-pass-per-candidate-file complexity as before; output still capped at 10; no new loops over external calls.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: test_test_acceptance_miner.py crossed 300 lines mid-build; split into test_test_acceptance_miner.py (208) + test_test_acceptance_miner_hygiene.py (187), both under the guideline; production file is 233 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No new producer/consumer pair or serialized-format change — reuses an existing pure detector function in-process; traced (Confidence Calibration) that spec_document.py writes the checked bullet verbatim, byte-identical to what the gate later re-reads.
